answer: The gale register is checked at draw time, nebula lists the eligible set, and sparrow seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 89 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 89 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Each impostor pays 20 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
